corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 1st-order ለ (ለብሳ, Amharic feminine gerundive 'having put on clothes', translating Ge'ez ልብስታ), not 6th-order ል.
The third character is clearly printed as ቶ (እሳቶው, the classic archaic Amharic 3rd-person plural pronoun 'they', subject of ይናገሩ ነበር), which was misread as ቸ.
